tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gur mgon lcam dral zhal bzhi pa dang bcas pa'i bstod pa bzhugs so// oṃ swasti/ bde ba chen po'i ngo bo nyid/ /stong pa nyid dang ro gcig pa/ /bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i/ /kye yi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal/ /rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las las/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir srin po'i skur/ /legs bstan bstan pa rjes skyong ba'i/ /gtum po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /bstan pa bsrung mdzad kun gyi gtso/ /chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing che/ /nag po khyod la bdag bstod do/ /dgra bgegs ma lus tshar gcod pa'i/ /dam tshig can rnams rjes 'dzin pas/ /thub pa'i bka' bzhin legs bsgrub pa'i/ /dam tshig can la bdag bstod do/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi/ /phrin las ngo mtshar bsam yas pas/ /'gro rnams bde la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /mgon mchog khyod la bdag bstod do/ /dpal ldan nag po 'khor bcas rnams/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis/ /byin rlabs bzhed dgu 'byung ba yi/ /gtor ma rgya mtsho 'di bzhes mdzod/ /sman rag phud dang 'dzam bu ti/ /'bras chan sran ma la dur bcas/ /sna tshogs rol mo la sogs pa'i/ /mchod rdzas sna tshogs 'di bzhes la/ /bde gshegs bstan pa bsrung ba dang / /bstan 'dzin dbu 'phang ches mtho bas/ /thos bsam bsgrub pa cher 'phel zhing / /'jig rten dge zhing dar bar mdzod/ /dpal mgon po la bstod pa ste dang po'o// ༈ //'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan ma/ /srid gsum gnas na mthu chen ma/ /lha chen dbang phyug dgyes mdzad ma/ /mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo khyod la bstod/ /khyod sku lhun po ltar brjid cing / /gar mkhan lta bur rnam sprul bas/ /'gro ba kun gyi gdug pa'i sems/ /rnam par 'joms mdzad khyod la bstod/ /ti se srin po'i gnas rnams dang / /dur khrod la sogs phyogs kun tu/ /rnam par rgyu bas legs nyes kyi/ /stangs 'dzin rjes gcod khyod la bstod/

/khyod la bstod cing gsol ba dang / /dam tshig can gyi skye bo rnams/ /brtse bas g.yel ba mi mnga' bar/ /rtag par gzigs pa khyod la bstod/ /dpal ldan mi pham srid gsum bdag /yum mchog e ka dza ṭīr bcas/ /las mkhan gnod sbyin yab yum che/ /bka' nyan ming sring 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir spyon dam bcas rjes dgongs la/ /bza' ba sna tshogs bca' bar ldan/ /btung ba sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig /sman rag la sogs gong bzhin sbyar/ dpal lha mo la bstod pa de gnyis pa'o// ༈ //stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid sku/ /gdug pa ma lus 'dul mdzad pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung yab yum la/ /gnyis med tshul gyis phyag 'tshal bstod/ /srid gsum dbang phyug dregs pa'i gtso/ /sku mdog cher nag 'jigs pa'i zhal/ /ha ha'i gad rgyangs cher sgrogs pas/ /rnam par sgeg pa khyod la bstod/ /phyogs bcu kun tu rnam rol yang / /nges pa bzhin du ti se dang / /bsil ba'i tshal dang po ta la/ /byang phyogs gnas bzhugs khyod la bstod/ /sna tshogs zhal dang phyag mtshan gyis/ /phrin las sna tshogs sgrub mdzad cing / /sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i/ /bram ze'i gzugs can khyod la bstod/ /khyod kyi sring mo chen mo bzhi/ /'jigs gzugs gri gug thod 'dzin pa/ /khyed thugs dgyes pa bskyed pa dang / /phyogs bcur las mdzad rnams la bstod/ /lha mchog nag po mthu bo che/ /yab yum sprul pa yang sprul dang / /lha srin sdebargyad 'khor dang bcas/ /tshur spyon sngon gyi dam dgongs la/ /thugs dam bzhin du legs bcas shing / /ting 'dzin la sogs sngar bzhin sbyar/ /zhal bzhi pa la bstod pa ste gsum pa'o// ༈ //dpal ldan sa skya pa'i bka' srung rnams la bstod pa mdor bsdus pa/ btsun pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ dad pa dang 'dun pa'i ngang tshul can gyi bshes gnyen yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan dpal gyis bskul ba'i ngor/

bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi mahā kā la lcam dral gyi drung du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen mdo stod pa yon tan 'bum gyis bgyis pa mchog tu grub par gyur cig/ //shubhaṃ// //gcig zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 bla ma dam pa/ gur mgon sogs la bstod pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
